form:FormGroup.label: Schedule Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the schedule is defined. Instant runs as often as possible. Frequency runs at a fixed interval. Cron runs at set times.

form:FormGroup.label: Quick Settings
form:FormGroup.helpText: Presets that fill in the expression with a common schedule.

form:FormGroup.label: Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: For Frequency, an interval such as 10m or 1h (units s, m, h, d). For Cron, six fields starting with seconds, e.g. 0 0 2 * * ? for 2am every day.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Frequency e.g. 10m; Cron has 6 fields starting with seconds.

form:FormGroup.label: Last Executed
form:FormGroup.helpText: When this last ran, or Never.

form:FormGroup.label: Next Scheduled Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: When this will next run, based on the expression. Shows an error if the expression is not valid. Select Calculate to update it.
